title: Mobility and injury prevention
learning_outcomes: Explain mobility and stability in the context of mobility and injury prevention.
Compare and distinguish load tolerance in the context of mobility and injury prevention.
Apply movement modification in the context of mobility and injury prevention.
Evaluate and justify decisions about referral boundaries in the context of mobility and injury prevention.

lessons.title: Mobility and stability
lessons.outcome: Explain mobility and stability in the context of mobility and injury prevention.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving mobility and stability; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to movement decision tree.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain mobility and stability from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of mobility and stability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Load tolerance
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish load tolerance in the context of mobility and injury prevention.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving load tolerance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to movement decision tree.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain load tolerance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of load tolerance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Movement modification
lessons.outcome: Apply movement modification in the context of mobility and injury prevention.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving movement modification; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to movement decision tree.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain movement modification from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of movement modification; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Referral boundaries
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about referral boundaries in the context of mobility and injury prevention.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving referral boundaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to movement decision tree.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain referral boundaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of referral boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of mobility and stability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of load tolerance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of movement modification; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of referral boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
